transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time to discuss the proposed Saturday credit-recovery program for Algebra I. Before I sign off on this request, I want to make sure we've done our standard procurement and implementation check. I'd like to hear from our instructional coach and finance coordinator regarding the classroom setup, the 20-seat enrollment figure, and the fact that we still have the instructor and funding source listed as pending. Let's walk through those details together so we can make sure this is ready for approval.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share an important update. My current student confirmations show that exactly 14 students will attend, not 20. Additionally, each of those students must complete work on the district learning platform during the sessions. The regular classroom listed in the request has no student computers, while the computer lab has 14 networked workstations that would meet this need. I collected these confirmations this week but have not yet updated the submitted request.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share something important regarding the funding. I reviewed the award letter for the credit-recovery grant this week, and it includes two key restrictions we need to account for. First, the grant permits only a certified mathematics teacher to lead the sessions. Second, it provides exactly $2,400 for this program, calculated as six sessions at a $400 instructor stipend. I have not yet entered these restrictions into the approval record, so the funding source and instructor requirements in the submitted request need to be updated to reflect these constraints before we proceed.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Update the request to reflect 14 seats, computer lab setting, certified math teacher requirement, and credit-recovery grant funding at $2,400 total.
Identify and assign a certified mathematics teacher to lead the six Saturday sessions before the program begins.
Enter the grant restrictions and $2,400 funding allocation into the official approval record before signing.
